scope: Official Impulse:Apothecary preset listing demo inspected read-only through rendered browser accessibility trees. No shopper interactions, screenshot, viewport, mobile, editor, checkout or performance testing.

sources.observation: Official Shopify Impulse:Apothecary listing View demo opened the Lumin Atelier storefront.

claims.observed: Home uses scent product hotspots, featured oils/candles and scent-family links; 110-item collection exposes filtering entry, sort choices and pagination; PDP combines fragrance narrative with FAQ/shipping content and related scents; cart is empty with recent/popular product shelves.
claims.risk: Filter, sort, hotspot, cart and recommendation behaviors were not tested; visible content does not establish product accuracy.
claims.vsn_guard: Test category/facet behavior and related-product relevance; ensure product usage text and recommendation taxonomy match item type.

claims.observed: Product and store copy includes ingredient, efficacy, sustainability, vegan, certification, burn-time, shipping and satisfaction statements.
claims.risk: Merchant-provided statements are unverified; the PDP explicitly labels this a non-purchasable demo and some page content appears inconsistent with the candle product.
claims.vsn_guard: Substantiate certification, ingredient, efficacy, product and returns claims and validate product-page content against its catalog record.
